capabilities: Display annotated backlink and in-note links in a header above notes
Show links from note properties, including file paths and URLs
Link to previous and next daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, and yearly notes
Show previous, next, or all files in the same folder with filtering and sorting
Pin arbitrary note content and collapse header links sharing a prefix
extras: Documentation references screenshots that are not included in the provided text; all configuration happens in the plugin settings page.
motivation: The README says the plugin 'makes navigating between notes faster and more convenient.'
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to show persistent, customizable navigation links at the top of notes, making movement between related notes slower.
summary: Navigation header plugin that displays customizable links (annotated backlinks, adjacent daily notes, folder neighbors) at the top of notes.
